title: Per-Issue Status Record
description: Compact committed record at agent-runtime/artifacts/status/issue-<N>.json (#670 P1 Option A). Replaces in-tree verbose review/validation bodies as the wave->main artifact-gate read path; verbose bodies move to CI artifact retention with sha256 integrity references recorded here.

wave.description: waveId this issue was merged under, when known (e.g. 'wave-658'); null when not yet assigned or unknown at migration time.

artifactRef.description: Locator for the verbose review body: a CI run artifact URL fragment (post-migration) or a git-history reference (migrated records).
Locator for the verbose validation body: a CI run artifact URL fragment (post-migration) or a git-history reference (migrated records).

gateVersion.description: Status-record schema/gate-semantics version; bump when the read-path contract changes.
